api.command: CLOUDFLARE_INCLUDE_PROCESS_ENV=true npx hush run -t api-workers -- pnpm --filter @slopcade/api dev

metro.command: node ../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --dev-client --port 8085

metro:amen.command: echo 'Starting Amen brand... (Note: Metro must be restarted to switch BRAND_ID)' && BRAND_ID=amen node ../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && BRAND_ID=amen WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && BRAND_ID=amen WITH_ROZENITE=true RCT_METRO_PORT=8085 npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --dev-client --port 8085 --clear

web.command: node ../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --web --port 8085

web:amen.command: echo 'Starting Amen brand (web)...' && BRAND_ID=amen node ../scripts/export-godot.mjs --once && BRAND_ID=amen WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- node scripts/preflight-check.mjs && BRAND_ID=amen WITH_ROZENITE=true npx hush run -t app -- npx expo start --web --port 8085 --clear

storybook.command: npx hush run -t app -- pnpm storybook
